Detailed Description

Per-client connection data.

Stored in network connection registry to track which session and participant this connection represents. Used by signaling relay to map participant_id to connection for message delivery.

Multiple-key creation is an ordered, counted sequence of Ed25519 proofs. No session is persisted until the entire sequence has passed validation.
